transfer-list.purpose: Coordinate moving items between source and target sets with selection, search handoff, validation, and transfer feedback.
entryConditions: Users need to move items between available and selected sets.
Large sets may require search handoff or multi-select semantics.
Transfer can be invalid, loading, partial, or permission constrained.
decisionTree: Use Multi Select when users only need a selected set.
Use Transfer List when source and target sets must be compared and moved.
Use Search when discovery spans a larger remote source.
failureModes: Source/target rows are custom list items.
Checkbox and selection semantics are duplicated.
Search is embedded instead of handed off.
successMetrics: Users can inspect source and target sets and move items intentionally.
Keyboard and screen reader users understand selection and transfer state.
Search/Multi Select remain boundaries, not hidden implementations.

slots.name: multi-selectBoundary
slots.purpose: Declares the Multi Select runtime composition boundary so this pattern composes Flow behavior instead of cloning it.

slots.name: searchBoundary
slots.purpose: Declares the Search runtime composition boundary so this pattern composes Flow behavior instead of cloning it.

accessibility: Expose source and target list labels.
Announce selected count and transfer result.
tests: Composes List, Checkbox, Badge, Button, Input, Inline Validation, and Toast.
Covers selecting, transferring, partial, invalid, empty, and disabled states.
Keeps Multi Select and Search as boundaries.
agentInstructions: Do not duplicate Multi Select internals.
Ask before transferring permissions, roles, money, or identity-sensitive records.
rejectIf: Source and target ownership is unclear.
